<div class="sect1">
<h2 id="_first_section_with_code_in_the_title"><a class="anchor" href="#_first_section_with_code_in_the_title"></a>1. First Section with <code>code</code> in the Title</h2>
<div class="sectionbody">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>A paragraph referring to <a href="#second-section">Table title</a> and to <a href="#anchor-in-table">the table anchor</a> and to <a href="#label-target">[label-target]</a>.<sup class="footnote">[<a id="_footnoteref_2" class="footnote" href="#_footnotedef_2" title="View footnote.">2</a>]</sup></p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<div class="title">A paragraph title</div>
<p>A titled paragraph.</p>
</div>
<div id="label-target" class="paragraph">
<p><strong>Purpose</strong></p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The paragraph under a label.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The configuration is the following:</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="highlight"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml">key: value
other: 1   # a long line that might wrap because it is long enough to wrap in a narrow column of text</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="literalblock">
<div class="content">
<pre>literal block
  with indentation</pre>
</div>
</div>
